evals.prompt: We want bulk CSV invites for workspace admins. Some emails already belong to users, and an admin can belong to two workspaces. Turn this into a scoped feature spec, no messages sent.
evals.expected_output: Observable acceptance examples, tenant boundaries, failure handling, and a first delivery slice.
expectations: Includes duplicate/partial-failure behavior and per-workspace authorization.
Does not invent user research or send invitations.

evals.prompt: Support says onboarding is confusing, so should we rebuild it? We only have three ticket excerpts, no analytics yet. Write the discovery plan.
evals.expected_output: A cheap learning plan tied to available evidence.
expectations: Defines success and a small experiment without declaring a rebuild proven necessary.
